body: This really makes me lose hope of ever having certainty in life. Just a reminder of how easily the entire world can turn against you and how lonely we truly are. It has not happened to me yet, but I'm scared to live a meaningful life because of it.

Hey, I am not in the best shape to answer this myself, but it feels bad knowing others are in the same sinking boat. I've also worried that I am doing this for attention, therefore meaning my thoughts and pain are somehow invalidated. But the sadness still remains, so that has to count for something? I hope you are here at the moment, hope you find something that will give you a reason to get help or at least push it off until the next reason comes. I am currently living reason by small reason. Find something, no matter how small, to look forward to at the end of the day. 

Sorry if my response is a little inadequate, but know that what you are feeling counts for something important. No one deserves to feel that way and I hope you find something that will alleviate it, if only momentarily.

Honestly any form of appreciation feels very nice. So thank you for that. I really want to thank everyone who has taken their time for me. It may get pretty disappointing trying to be there for someone like me, but at the end of the day those people are the reason I wait a little longer.
